company.name: GoCardless
company.shortDescription: GoCardless provides a bank-payment platform focused on helping businesses collect and manage payments from customers’ bank accounts.
company.description: GoCardless is a financial-technology company that provides a global bank-payment platform focused on helping businesses collect and manage payments directly from customers’ bank accounts. It enables companies to set up and process recurring payments as well as one-off payments via direct debit, eliminating manual chasing of invoices and simplifying cash flow management. The platform offers tools for payment collection, real-time tracking, reporting, and notifications, and it supports transactions in 30+ countries through direct debit schemes and open-banking-based payment features. Users can integrate GoCardless with their existing business systems using its API or through pre-built partnerships with accounting and billing software such as Xero, QuickBooks, and Salesforce to automate payment workflows and reconciliation.

productsAndServices.description: A service for collecting customer bank payments across more than 30 countries and settling funds locally or into an existing bank account with integrated foreign-exchange conversion.
